publishedDeadlines.note: Annual international deadline; earlier program dates may apply.

deadlines.label: Domestic GFS fellowship faculty nomination
deadlines.note: Fall 2027; US citizen/permanent resident, GPA 3.5 and faculty nomination required; not general admission deadline.

applicationFee.note: International75USD; domestic65. Central McNair waiver and limited competitive departmental codes; no program-specific code offer confirmed. International applicants must confirm category eligibility before payment.

english.note: PTE 58 accepted; Duolingo not accepted. Listed exempt countries or accredited US degree may waive testing. TA speaking requirements are separate.

documents: Uploaded transcripts and degree certificates; certified English translations for international records
Bachelor-only PhD: additional motivation page and research-supervisor recommendation
requirements.note: Bachelor-only PhD requires GPA 3.5, demonstrated research and additional motivation statement. Preparation in algebra/calculus/statistics, chemistry/biochemistry/organic chemistry, physics and biological sciences; waivers/deficiency courses possible.

funding.note: Assistantships competitive. Fall 2027 GFS fellowship: up to two domestic US-citizen/permanent-resident awards, $30,000 yearly plus tuition/fees for at least three years subject to progress; GPA 3.5 and nominated faculty adviser required. Not an international award.
